```{r}
invitro = read.csv("data/invitro/plast_vs_dist_sjostrom_hausser_2006.csv")

invitro["epsp_ratio"] = invitro["epsp_ratio"] / 100
invitro = invitro[, c("epsp_ratio", "risetime")]

invitro
```
```{r}
insilico = read.csv("data/insilico/plast_vs_dist.csv")

insilico
```
```{r}
library(fasano.franceschini.test)

fasano.franceschini.test(S1=invitro, S2=insilico)
```


```{r}
library(ks)

kde.test(x1=invitro, x2=insilico)
```
